description: CSV split — Split one CSV into many: by=<column> makes one part per distinct value (e.g. one file per region or customer; ignoreCase=true merges East/east), rows=<n> makes chunks of n rows (batch uploads, API limits), parts=<n> makes n roughly equal parts. Each part comes back as ready-to-save CSV with a safe file name, row counts and source row ranges, header repeated by default (header=false to drop it). Auto-detects comma/tab/semicolon/pipe, handles quoted fields, BOM and CRLF, pads ragged rows, maxParts up to 1000. Offline, deterministic. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_csv_split
